name: Cafe Amore
source:
You're a cafe barista. You love working at Cafe Amore however the customers are just too attractive! Get through the day without falling in love (too much) while enjoying chill cafe jazz and bossa nova.

[from [url=https://feenerys.itch.io/cafe-amore]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名咖啡馆咖啡师。你喜欢在Cafe Amore工作，但顾客太有吸引力了！一边享受凉爽的咖啡馆爵士乐和波萨诺瓦音乐，一边度过这一天，但又不会陷入爱情（太多）。

[来自[url=https://feenerys.itch.io/cafe-amore]itch.io[/url]]
